title: SSO login fails for enterprise users
description: Single sign-on returns a 500 error for roughly half of enterprise accounts. Reported by a customer on the support portal.

title: Dashboard widgets flicker on refresh
description: Widgets reload twice and flicker whenever the dashboard auto-refreshes. Reproduced on staging with a clean profile.

title: App crashes on launch
description: The application crashes immediately on startup for every user after the 3.2 update. No workaround exists. Steps to reproduce are attached to the ticket.

title: Order created twice on timeout
description: A slow card authorization creates the order twice, double-charging the customer. Seen on build 4821.

title: Search returns no results after upgrade
description: Queries that worked last week now return empty result sets. Reported by the QA team during regression.

title: Auth tokens logged in plaintext
description: Session tokens are written in plaintext to the debug console, enabling session hijack. Reported by a customer on the support portal.

title: Help tooltip truncated on narrow screens
description: The tooltip on the help icon is cut off on narrow viewports. Reproduced on staging with a clean profile.

title: Sidebar mixes capitalization styles
description: Menu items mix title case and sentence case in the navigation sidebar. Steps to reproduce are attached to the ticket.

title: Confirmation dialog renders off-center
description: The confirmation modal is misaligned on smaller laptop screens. Steps to reproduce are attached to the ticket.

title: Dashboard widgets flicker on refresh
description: Widgets reload twice and flicker whenever the dashboard auto-refreshes. Steps to reproduce are attached to the ticket.

title: Duplicate charges on payment retry
description: Retrying a timed-out payment creates a second charge and corrupts the ledger state. Seen on build 4821.

title: Sync worker deadlock under load
description: The background sync worker deadlocks under load and the whole pipeline stalls indefinitely. Seen on both web and mobile.

title: Table sort resets on pagination
description: Sorting a table is lost as soon as you move to the next page. Seen on build 4821.

title: Footer copyright year is outdated
description: The footer still shows last year in the copyright line. Reproduced on staging with a clean profile.

title: Reports page loads very slowly
description: The reports page takes over twenty seconds to load with default filters. Reproduced on staging with a clean profile.
